title: Toolkit: Frequency Report
prompt: Using Counter, write top_words(text, n) that returns the n most common lowercase words as a list of (word, count) tuples (ties: higher count first, then insertion order — Counter handles it). Print top_words(text, 2) for text = \"to be or not to be\" as two lines in the form: word=4

tests.name: top words in order
tests.code:
assert printed == ["to=2", "be=2"], f"got {printed}"
assert "Counter" in code and "def top_words" in code, "use Counter inside top_words"
tests.hint: Counter(text.split()).most_common(n) is already ordered; format f"{w}={c}".
